newsitem.title: SPAIN: BBV's Gesbanque to buy Cerus banking unit deposits.
newsitem.headline: BBV's Gesbanque to buy Cerus banking unit deposits.

text.p: Gesbanque, a Belgian unit of Spanish banking group Banco Bilbao Vizcaya, has agreed to buy the client deposits of Dumenil-Leble Bank for 1.3 billion Belgian francs, BBV said in a statement on Friday.
Dumenil-Leble, a former unit of Italian businessman Carlo de Benedetti's French holding company Cerus, was closed in January.
Gesbanque will also acquire a portfolio of current credit contracts for 35 million Belgian francs, BBV said.

"With this operation, Gesbanque will be able to increase its clientele, which will be able to count with a network of eighty branches (between its own networks and appointed agents) situated in the main economic centres of Belgium," it said.
